prompt: What percentage of the global mobile population is covered by 2G networks in 2024, according to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU)?
answer: According to the ITU, **98.1% of the world’s population was covered by at least a 2G mobile network in 2024**. This measures people within range of a mobile signal, regardless of whether they subscribed to or used the service.
